finding: The 7-point scale captures severity but not cause. Every occupant in the round volunteered a cause the instrument could not record; administrators then cannot act and assessors cannot verify.
disposition: Shipped - descriptor chips added to the occupant view.

finding: A single global comment box arrives too late; participants want to annotate at the moment of rating.
disposition: Shipped - optional free-text note per domain, collapsed by default.

finding: Stated duration differs between the hero banner and the stat card.
disposition: Shipped - duration reconciled to “under five minutes” across hero, stat and chip.

finding: Tags must be optional and counted separately from the rating scales, otherwise participants either force-choose or self-censor.
disposition: Shipped - chips are optional and counted independently of ratings.

finding: No “not applicable” path for a domain the space physically cannot deliver.
disposition: Deferred to next round - needs a schema decision on how N/A affects the domain mean.

finding: Pluralisation defect: “1 domains”.
disposition: Shipped - pluralisation pass.

finding: Chip vocabulary must use occupants' own words and cover the “no alternative space” case, not only intensity.
disposition: Shipped - eight chips: glare, stuffy, echo, too warm, corridor noise, too dim, nowhere quiet, draughty.

finding: Domain labels use assessment vocabulary rather than occupant vocabulary; “thermal comfort” queried by two of five occupants.
disposition: Shipped - plain-language helper text under each domain label.

finding: Global comment box below the fold was not discovered at all by 1 of 5 occupants.
disposition: Shipped - replaced by per-domain notes, collapsed by default (collapsed default explicitly validated by this participant).

finding: Free-text is effectively unavailable on mobile; tap-to-answer is the only realistic mobile input.
disposition: Shipped - chips carry the mobile case; note stays optional.

finding: Hot-deskers need the response scoped to a named space.
disposition: Deferred - space-level scoping is a schema change, logged for the next round.

finding: No project context or switcher; participant resorted to multiple tabs and reported real-world mis-entry risk.
disposition: Shipped - pinned toolbar with project dropdown and Add/Edit project.

finding: Raw response count without an enrolled-occupant denominator is the single biggest credibility gap; named by 4 of 5 administrators and 3 of 5 reviewers.
disposition: Shipped - response rate against enrolled occupants.

finding: Fixed period presets cannot express a rolling GRIHA window.
disposition: Shipped - survey-period dropdown plus custom range with real From/To pickers; all metrics, curve and captions recompute.

finding: No accrual view of responses over time.
disposition: Shipped - cumulative accrual curve.

finding: Project identity carries no descriptive context.
disposition: Shipped - caption line with type, area, occupancy and climate zone.

finding: No indication of how far the project is from the next credit point.
disposition: Shipped - distance-to-next-credit-point bar.

finding: Domain scores are not actionable; administrators need ranked complaint descriptors to raise work orders against.
disposition: Shipped - complaint-descriptor bars in the administrator view.

finding: Logging a remediation produced no visible change, breaking the feedback loop and discouraging future logging.
disposition: Shipped - complaint descriptors fall when a remediation is logged.

finding: Long single-scroll page causes repeated loss of place.
disposition: Shipped - six-tab sticky sub-nav: Results, Responses, Badges, Improve, Submit, Reports & team.

finding: Exported file name carries no date.
disposition: Shipped - dated report file.

finding: Submission could be sent with no review step; one participant sent unintentionally during the session.
disposition: Shipped - review-before-sending summary built on the five-domain ring, with a confirm gate: Send stays locked until confirmed.

finding: A confirmation can go stale if evidence or remediations change after it is given.
disposition: Shipped - any later remediation or evidence toggle re-locks the send.

finding: The five-domain ring is the strongest single visual for panel presentation.
disposition: Shipped - ring used as the hero of the review screen.

finding: No in-app path to create or edit a project.
disposition: Shipped - Add/Edit project in the pinned toolbar.

finding: Report generation lacks type, period, cover selection and preview.
disposition: Shipped - report generator with type, period, cover picker, live preview and dated file.

finding: No role separation between viewing, adding data and submitting.
disposition: Shipped - team roles with invite.

finding: Bulk add/remove across projects not supported.
disposition: Deferred - single-project management ships now; bulk operations logged.

finding: Portfolio floor-area/emissions statistics and LEED-style tiers explicitly argued against by the participant who initially requested them.
disposition: Out of scope - confirmed excluded.

finding: An invalid custom range renders an unexplained blank page; participant's first instinct was to abandon the task.
disposition: Shipped - invalid range shows an explicit empty state.

finding: Caption text failed contrast at small sizes.
disposition: Shipped - contrast pass to ≈4.7:1 across captions and secondary text.

finding: Sub-nav labels alone are not discriminable to a low-familiarity user.
disposition: Shipped - sub-nav gains icons, hover states, an active pill in #0e1c14, and sticks below the header.

finding: No discoverable invite-by-email path.
disposition: Shipped - team roles with invite by email.

finding: Flat stat row reads as decoration; no visual hierarchy and no units.
disposition: Shipped - stat carousel (09 / 08 / 18 / 4.1k) with the leading card enlarged and prev/next stepping; units labelled.

finding: No pooled, domain-level view across reporting buildings.
disposition: Shipped - pool domain rings.

finding: No this-building-versus-pool comparison.
disposition: Shipped - benchmark with pool average markers.

finding: Credit mix across submissions not visible.
disposition: Shipped - credit-mix donut.

finding: No reviewer/assessor permission separation.
disposition: Shipped - reviewer roles with add-by-email.

finding: The Council's primary decision - whether to recalibrate - is unsupported; no strategy adoption data exists.
disposition: Shipped - strategy adoption leaderboard, ranked, flagging anything under 35% as a guidance issue.

finding: No place to stage candidate strategies by climate zone.
disposition: Shipped - climate-zone pipeline below the leaderboard, staged and tagged by domain.

finding: Navigation labels should name the decision, not the data.
disposition: Shipped - six-tab sub-nav: Submissions, Pool analysis, Strategies, Geography, Schema decision, Reviewers.

finding: Benchmark bars carry no reference point; the comparison the view exists for cannot be made.
disposition: Shipped - pool average markers on the benchmark.

finding: Small-pool means need their n shown alongside.
disposition: Shipped - pool count shown with the benchmark.

finding: CSV export of underlying figures requested for ad-hoc cuts.
disposition: Deferred - explicitly non-blocking per participant.

finding: Carousel must allow direct selection, not forced stepping.
disposition: Shipped - prev/next plus direct card selection.

finding: Schematic map is geographically wrong and undermines trust in the whole view; zone-based task could not be completed.
disposition: Shipped - real India map built on Natural Earth geometry, authored as a separate file and embedded in the Council view.

finding: Buildings must be identifiable from the map itself.
disposition: Shipped - hover a dot for the building.

finding: Zone-level comparison is the regional decision unit.
disposition: Shipped - dots coloured by climate zone; mean credit per zone.

finding: Single long Council page conflates six distinct decision contexts.
disposition: Shipped - six-tab sub-nav: Submissions, Pool analysis, Strategies, Geography, Schema decision, Reviewers.

finding: Navigation must remain visible during screen-shared review calls.
disposition: Shipped - sub-nav sticky below the header, with hover states and an active pill in #0e1c14.

finding: LEED-tier equivalence and financial modelling actively argued against.
disposition: Out of scope - confirmed excluded.

finding: The seasonal protocol criterion states no content requirements, so submissions arrive incomplete and cost weeks in correspondence.
disposition: Shipped - required protocol contents enumerated: seasonal setpoints; fan-first sequencing; the mixed-mode changeover rule to mechanical cooling; night purge and damper schedules; blind and lighting rules.

finding: Criterion bundled under a shared toggle; cannot be assessed or evidenced independently.
disposition: Shipped - seasonal protocol given its own File-evidence toggle.

finding: Badge criterion counts were hardcoded and disagreed with the listed items.
disposition: Shipped - criterion counts computed from the list.

finding: “Energy Champion” badge name does not describe its criteria in an IEQ index.
disposition: Shipped - renamed Microclimate Champion with five criteria.

finding: No requirement for operational logs; the criterion could be satisfied by a document alone.
disposition: Shipped - two seasons of logs required (BMS trend data or facilities log), covering the hot-dry pre-monsoon and the humid monsoon period for this climate.

finding: A single season, or an undifferentiated year, does not evidence that the protocol was followed.
disposition: Shipped - two named seasons specified rather than a rolling year.

finding: No owner recorded against the protocol.
disposition: Shipped - responsible facilities role captured (see REV-03).

finding: Health Leadership badge under-specified; CO₂ threshold must be preserved.
disposition: Shipped - Health Leadership expanded to six criteria, CO₂ under 800 ppm retained.

finding: Glare-free zones mis-grouped.
disposition: Shipped - Digital Adaptation expanded to six criteria including glare-free zones.

finding: Criteria give no statement of what sufficient evidence looks like, pushing cost onto supervision.
disposition: Shipped - required contents listed on the criterion.

finding: Long criterion text overflows its container at 1366×768.
disposition: Shipped - overflow fixes.

finding: Two seasons of logs can be satisfied with identical schedules; the criterion's actual intent - demonstrated seasonal difference - was unverifiable.
disposition: Shipped - evidence of seasonal change required: the same spaces must be shown running differently in each season.

finding: The administrator's review summary and the reviewer's view must be the same artefact.
disposition: Shipped - review-before-sending summary built on the same five-domain ring.
